corpus: 32 real ChEMBL LpxC molecules with measured pChEMBL ground truth

SAFETY_INVARIANT.statement: APPROVE requires kleene_and of all three channels == +1; an UNMEASURED channel can never yield +1
SAFETY_INVARIANT.result: HOLDS - verified against the kernel's real k3_logic.rs

accuracy.note: the SAME two measured-inactives that outranked real actives in the ROC

verdict: PROVEN: the ternary algebra is sound and the safety property holds - an unmeasured channel never produces an approval (0 violations over real data). NOT PROVEN: that the gate is accurate. It produced a 14.3% false-approval rate, and the cause is the EVIDENCE, not the logic: docking scores put two 33-63 uM inactives in the approve band. Sound algebra cannot rescue unreliable inputs - it can only guarantee it never guesses.
